🌿 Liam checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.

🔥 The fire settles. Sam has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A line of ducks, walking in perfect formation. In the dark. That is not normal duck behavior. — I put it down today." "The hissing stops. The line leans forward — it advances, and contact burns." "Every beak in the line, one coordinated bite." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Liam says quietly "And you're still standing." Violet says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 40s, with a scarred cheek, the plumber has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Stripes flowing where no wind blows — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the man in his 50s, with calloused knuckles, the army medic breathes "And you're still standing." the man in his 20s breathes "We've been walking past those."
